title: Fix Toolbar Element Sizing Inconsistencies
description: Analyze and fix inconsistent sizing of toolbar elements - some elements appear to have different heights/dimensions within the same toolbar group
summary: Fixed toolbar element sizing inconsistencies by changing Toggle action container from absolute sizing (w-small h-small = 1.0rem fixed) to relative sizing (aspect-square h-full) so it properly fills the parent's content height. All tests pass.
